name: Yaoshang
description: Meitei spring festival — 5 days of celebration equivalent to Holi, with night-long devotional songs (Thabal Chongba)

name: Cheiraoba
description: Meitei New Year — families climb hills in the morning and celebrate renewal with feasting

name: Lai Haraoba
description: Ancient Meitei festival — elaborate rituals honoring the indigenous deities (Umang Lai)

name: Heikru Hitongba
description: Boat racing festival on Manipur River — prayers to Goddess Panthoibi

name: Ningol Chakouba
description: Major Meitei festival — married women invited to brothers' homes for a grand feast
